card.name: Digits and decimal points in dose tables
card.fires_on: The decimal point or a leading digit inside a number in tables of doses, radiation values or ranges, where the next digit is expected. Also a point inside a DOI-style number.

modes.label: Decimal point in table
modes.description: The point after a leading 0 in radiation dose tables, right before the next digits.

modes.label: Digit in dose range
modes.description: A digit starting the second number of a range or step, just before a decimal point.

card.writes: It suppresses the digits 2 through 8, so the model is less likely to write a plain digit next.
card.plain: It fires inside numbers in dose tables and ranges, where a decimal part comes next.
